title: Entitled 22-Year-Old Turns Traffic Stop Into Pure Chaos
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 19th, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle that the license plate belonged to another vehicle. When the officer approached the female, she was on the phone with her mom, completely ignoring the officer. She was very confrontational and refused to listen to the officer commands. The female could not give a straight answer as to why the plate did not match her vehicle. She also could not provide her driver license and could only provide her security license. The officer asked the lady to step out of the vehicle and she became very hesitant and continued not listening which forced the officer to arrest her. After she was placed under arrest, she became even more belligerent. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
